comment: Post-release acceptance scenarios (docs/61), run by tools/rungic_acceptance.py after every deploy (smoke) and for release candidates (full). Each scenario names a check function and its parameters; results go to .work/acceptance/<release>/<time>/ and metrics are compared with the previous release's report. Every scenario restores what it changes. 'manual' lists what automatic results do not replace.

scenarios.title: KWin and plasmashell running, session environment written
No failed desktop or bridge user units
No crash signatures during the deploy and the run, except known ones
The phone's KScreen output matches the Android display size
Android text input reaches the focused drawer search, which filters to the matching app
PipeWire camera delivers varied frames with increasing timestamps and goes idle after
A Wayland client inhibiting idle keeps the phone screen on while it does (rungic-idle-probe through KWin to the host)
A (quiet) stream enters the default sink, which suspends again afterwards
The default source records a non-zero level and suspends afterwards
Rime engine commits Chinese first candidates; a focused Qt text field brings up the keyboard
Launch and close an app through the launcher by accessible names
The assistant's screen appears as KWin output CAST-n of the host output's size and goes away when turned off
KScreen applies and reverts a scale change on the phone output
Hardware encode (GStreamer) of a test pattern, decode through FFmpeg, duration and frames checked
The recording quick setting writes a playable file with video and audio tracks
Rungic rename, phase B: no installed package, unit or package name is still moto (docs/70)
Frame timing of a scripted scroll, compared with the previous release

manual: Visual defects and image quality (display, camera, recording)
Acoustic quality of speaker and microphone
Audio/video synchronisation of recordings, judged by eye and ear
Typing pinyin on the virtual keyboard and committing Chinese (Android key events bypass Rime)
Rime candidate UI and typing feel
Casting to a TV (needs a real receiver, docs/58)
